name: Hakuouki Yuugiroku
source:
Chizuru (Main Character, name change possible) notices that the members of Shinsengumi are secretly having a meeting and so Hijikata tells her to report to him if she finds out anything. She overhears Itou talking about how he lost something precious and that he has to find it before it falls in the other members' hands. When Chizuru finds and opens the box that Itou lost, suddenly everyone goes into chibi mode and now Chizuru (and your dude of choice) have to figure out a way to return back to normal. The challenge is, you must successfully pass a bunch of mini games to get to the bottom of things!

Sources: https://sandeian.wordpress.com
            http://breadmasterlee.com/
translation:
千鹤（主角，可改名）注意到新选组的成员正在秘密开会，因此土方让她如果发现任何情况就向他报告。她无意中听到伊藤谈论他如何失去了一些珍贵的东西，并且他必须在它落入其他成员手中之前找到它。当千鹤找到并打开伊藤丢失的盒子时，突然每个人都进入赤壁模式，现在千鹤（和你选择的家伙）必须找到一种方法恢复正常。挑战是，你必须成功通过一堆小游戏才能弄清事情的真相！

资料来源：https://sandeian.wordpress.com
